gaps.title: No CoAP protocol support
gaps.description: The context broker only supports HTTP/NGSI-LD. Constrained IoT devices typically use CoAP (RFC 7252) for communication. Without CoAP support, low-power sensors cannot interact with the broker directly.
gaps.impact: Cannot deploy on constrained devices (Class 0/1 per RFC 7228). Forces all devices through HTTP gateways, adding latency and cost.
gaps.recommendation: Add a CoAP client adapter (e.g., using aiocoap or libcoap) that maps CoAP resources to NGSI-LD entities. Support CoAP observe for subscriptions.

gaps.title: No LwM2M protocol support
gaps.description: LwM2M (OMA Lightweight M2M) is the standard device management protocol for IoT. The broker has no LwM2M client/server, preventing device registration, firmware management, and remote configuration.
gaps.impact: Cannot manage IoT devices using the standard LwM2M protocol. No device bootstrap, no remote configuration, no firmware update capability.
gaps.recommendation: Implement an LwM2M client (e.g., using wakaama or leshan) that bridges LwM2M objects to NGSI-LD entities. Map LwM2M Object 3 (Device) to NGSI-LD Device model.

gaps.title: No MQTT protocol support in broker
gaps.description: While data_pipeline.py has an MQTT client, the context broker itself cannot accept MQTT-based entity updates. Many IoT platforms use MQTT as the primary ingestion protocol.
gaps.impact: Cannot ingest sensor data via MQTT directly into the context broker. Requires an external MQTT-to-NGSI-LD bridge.
gaps.recommendation: Add MQTT ingestion support to the broker (e.g., using paho-mqtt) that maps MQTT topics to NGSI-LD entity updates. Support MQTT 5.0 features.

gaps.title: No device registration and provisioning
gaps.description: The broker has no device management API. There is no way to register new devices, provision credentials, or manage device lifecycle (activate/deactivate/retire).
gaps.impact: Cannot onboard new IoT devices programmatically. No device identity management. No device grouping or tagging.
gaps.recommendation: Add device management endpoints: POST /devices (register), GET /devices/{id} (get), PATCH /devices/{id} (update), DELETE /devices/{id} (deregister). Support device groups and tags.

gaps.title: No OTA firmware update support
gaps.description: No Over-The-Air (OTA) update mechanism. Cannot push firmware updates to devices, track update status, or roll back failed updates.
gaps.impact: Cannot remotely update device firmware. Physical access required for updates. No update scheduling or canary deployments.
gaps.recommendation: Implement OTA update service: POST /devices/{id}/firmware (upload), POST /devices/{id}/update (trigger), GET /devices/{id}/update-status (track). Support delta updates and A/B partitioning.

gaps.title: No device configuration management
gaps.description: Cannot remotely configure device parameters (sampling rate, thresholds, reporting interval). No configuration versioning or rollback.
gaps.impact: Cannot optimize device behavior remotely. Configuration changes require physical access or custom protocols.
gaps.recommendation: Add configuration management: GET/PUT /devices/{id}/config. Support configuration templates, versioning, and rollback.

gaps.title: No device health monitoring
gaps.description: No heartbeat, health check, or device status monitoring. Cannot detect offline devices or anomalous behavior.
gaps.impact: Cannot detect device failures proactively. No alerting on device health issues.
gaps.recommendation: Add health monitoring: POST /devices/{id}/heartbeat, GET /devices/{id}/health. Implement device status tracking (online/offline/error) and alerting.

gaps.title: No sensor data validation
gaps.description: Sensor readings are stored without any validation. No range checks, type validation, schema validation, or anomaly detection. Invalid or corrupted data is persisted silently.
gaps.impact: Data quality issues propagate downstream. Analytics and ML models receive invalid data. No data quality metrics.
gaps.recommendation: Add validation layer: schema validation (JSON Schema), range checks (min/max per sensor type), rate-of-change checks, and anomaly detection (z-score, IQR). Reject or flag invalid readings.

gaps.title: No data quality metrics
gaps.description: No tracking of data quality metrics: completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency. No data quality dashboard or reporting.
gaps.impact: Cannot assess data reliability. No SLA monitoring for data quality.
gaps.recommendation: Implement data quality metrics: % complete readings, % within expected range, latency distribution, missing data intervals. Expose via API.

gaps.title: No model validation
gaps.description: Smart data models are created without validation. No schema validation, no property type checking, no required field enforcement, no value range validation.
gaps.impact: Invalid entities can be created. No guarantee of data model compliance. Downstream consumers may fail.
gaps.recommendation: Add model validation: validate against FIWARE Smart Data Models schemas, check required fields, validate property types and ranges, enforce NGSI-LD compliance.

gaps.title: No horizontal scaling support
gaps.description: All components (MQTT, Kafka, TimescaleDB) are in-memory singletons. No clustering, partitioning, or load balancing. Cannot scale horizontally.
gaps.impact: Single point of failure. Cannot handle high throughput. No fault tolerance.
gaps.recommendation: Add clustering support: Kafka consumer groups, TimescaleDB multi-node, MQTT broker clustering. Implement partitioning by sensor_id or tenant.

gaps.title: No backpressure handling
gaps.description: No backpressure mechanism when consumers are slow or storage is full. Messages are queued in memory without bounds, risking OOM.
gaps.impact: System crashes under load. No graceful degradation. Data loss when queues overflow.
gaps.recommendation: Implement backpressure: bounded queues, flow control, load shedding, and circuit breakers. Add monitoring of queue depths.

gaps.title: No data retention policy
gaps.description: Only manual delete_old_data exists. No automatic retention policy, tiered storage, or data lifecycle management.
gaps.impact: Storage grows unboundedly. No compliance with data retention regulations. High storage costs.
gaps.recommendation: Implement retention policies: automatic deletion after N days, tiered storage (hot/warm/cold), compression of old data, archival to object storage.

gaps.title: No data downsampling
gaps.description: No automatic downsampling of old data. Raw high-frequency data is stored forever, wasting storage and slowing queries.
gaps.impact: Storage inefficiency. Slow queries over long time ranges. No trade-off between resolution and retention.
gaps.recommendation: Implement downsampling: store raw data for recent period, downsampled aggregates for older data. Use TimescaleDB continuous aggregates.

gaps.title: No support for large-scale placement
gaps.description: Greedy Set Cover is O(n_sensors * n_targets) per iteration. For large deployments (10k+ sensors, 100k+ targets), this is too slow.
gaps.impact: Cannot optimize placement for large farms or regional deployments. Timeout or excessive memory usage.
gaps.recommendation: Add spatial indexing (R-tree, k-d tree) for faster coverage queries. Implement parallel greedy or distributed Set Cover. Add approximation guarantees.

gaps.title: No pagination support
gaps.description: list_entities has a limit parameter but no offset/cursor. Cannot paginate through large result sets.
gaps.impact: Cannot retrieve large entity sets. Memory exhaustion on large responses. Poor API usability.
gaps.recommendation: Add pagination: offset/limit or cursor-based pagination. Support streaming for large result sets.

gaps.title: No batch operations
gaps.description: No bulk create/update/delete operations. Each entity operation is a separate HTTP request. Inefficient for large-scale updates.
gaps.impact: Slow bulk operations. High API call volume. No atomicity guarantees.
gaps.recommendation: Add batch operations: POST /entities/bulk (create), PATCH /entities/bulk (update), DELETE /entities/bulk (delete). Support NGSI-LD batch operations.

gaps.title: No MQTT QoS 1/2 support
gaps.description: MQTT client only supports QoS 0 (fire-and-forget). No delivery guarantees, no exactly-once semantics.
gaps.impact: Data loss when network is unreliable. No delivery guarantees for critical sensor data.
gaps.recommendation: Implement QoS 1 (at least once) and QoS 2 (exactly once). Add message deduplication for QoS 2.

gaps.title: No MQTT retained messages
gaps.description: No support for MQTT retained messages. New subscribers cannot get the last known value immediately.
gaps.impact: New consumers must wait for next reading. No last-known-value for dashboards or alerts.
gaps.recommendation: Add retained message support: publish with retain=True, store last value per topic, deliver to new subscribers.

gaps.title: No MQTT Last Will and Testament
gaps.description: No LWT support. Cannot detect device disconnections gracefully or publish offline notifications.
gaps.impact: Cannot detect device failures. No automatic offline alerting.
gaps.recommendation: Add LWT support: register will message on connect, broker publishes on unexpected disconnect.

gaps.title: No MQTT TLS/SSL support
gaps.description: No TLS/SSL support for MQTT connections. Credentials and data transmitted in plaintext.
gaps.impact: Security vulnerability. No encryption in transit. No mutual TLS authentication.
gaps.recommendation: Add TLS/SSL support: CA certificates, client certificates, mutual TLS. Support TLS 1.3.

gaps.title: No MQTT authentication
gaps.description: No username/password or token-based authentication for MQTT connections.
gaps.impact: Unauthorized access to MQTT broker. No device authentication.
gaps.recommendation: Add authentication: username/password, token-based (JWT), mutual TLS. Support ACLs per device.

gaps.title: No Kafka consumer groups
gaps.description: No consumer group support. Cannot scale consumers horizontally or load-balance message processing.
gaps.impact: Cannot scale message processing. No fault tolerance for consumers.
gaps.recommendation: Add consumer group support: group membership, partition assignment, rebalancing, offset management.

gaps.title: No Kafka schema registry integration
gaps.description: No schema registry integration. Messages are JSON without schema enforcement or evolution.
gaps.impact: Schema evolution issues. No compatibility checks. No Avro/Protobuf support.
gaps.recommendation: Add schema registry integration: Confluent Schema Registry or Apicurio. Support Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema.

gaps.title: No Kafka exactly-once semantics
gaps.description: No exactly-once processing semantics. Risk of duplicate processing on consumer failure.
gaps.impact: Data duplication. Inaccurate aggregations. No transactional guarantees.
gaps.recommendation: Implement exactly-once semantics: idempotent producers, transactional consumers, deduplication.

gaps.title: No Kafka stream processing
gaps.description: No stream processing capabilities: windowing, joins, aggregations, pattern detection. Only simple pub/sub.
gaps.impact: Cannot do real-time analytics. No complex event processing. No stream-table joins.
gaps.recommendation: Add stream processing: Kafka Streams or ksqlDB integration. Support windowing, joins, aggregations, CEP.

gaps.title: No data anomaly detection
gaps.description: No anomaly detection on sensor readings. Cannot detect sensor drift, stuck values, or outliers automatically.
gaps.impact: Undetected sensor failures. No data quality monitoring. No proactive maintenance.
gaps.recommendation: Add anomaly detection: z-score, IQR, isolation forest, or autoencoders. Support configurable thresholds per sensor type.

gaps.title: No data gap detection
gaps.description: No detection of missing data gaps. Cannot identify when sensors stop reporting or data is lost.
gaps.impact: Silent data loss. No alerting on missing data. Incomplete analytics.
gaps.recommendation: Add gap detection: expected reading intervals, gap identification, alerting on missing data.

gaps.title: No data interpolation
gaps.description: No interpolation of missing data points. Gaps in time-series data are not filled.
gaps.impact: Incomplete analytics. No smooth visualizations. Missing data affects ML models.
gaps.recommendation: Add interpolation: linear, spline, or Kalman filter. Support configurable interpolation methods.

gaps.title: No device shadow support
gaps.description: No device shadow (digital twin) support. Cannot store desired vs reported state for devices.
gaps.impact: Cannot manage device state asynchronously. No offline device management. No state reconciliation.
gaps.recommendation: Add device shadow: GET/PUT /devices/{id}/shadow. Support desired/reported state, version tracking, and delta computation.

gaps.title: No device command dispatch
gaps.description: No command dispatch mechanism. Cannot send commands to devices (e.g., start/stop sampling, change mode).
gaps.impact: Cannot control devices remotely. No actuator support. No device automation.
gaps.recommendation: Add command dispatch: POST /devices/{id}/commands. Support command queuing, status tracking, and timeout handling.

gaps.title: No NGSI-LD temporal API support
gaps.description: No support for NGSI-LD temporal queries (GET /temporal/entities). Cannot query entity history or time-series data.
gaps.impact: Cannot retrieve historical entity state. No temporal analytics. No time-travel queries.
gaps.recommendation: Add temporal API support: GET /temporal/entities, GET /temporal/entities/{id}/attrs. Support time-range queries and temporal aggregation.

gaps.title: No NGSI-LD geo API support
gaps.description: No support for NGSI-LD geo queries (near, within, intersects, etc.). Cannot query entities by location.
gaps.impact: Cannot do spatial queries. No proximity-based analytics. No geo-fencing.
gaps.recommendation: Add geo API support: GET /entities?georel=near&geometry=point. Support geo-fencing and spatial indexing.

gaps.title: No NGSI-LD subscription update support
gaps.description: Subscriptions can only be created and deleted, not updated. Cannot modify subscription criteria or notification endpoint.
gaps.impact: Must delete and recreate subscriptions to change them. No subscription versioning.
gaps.recommendation: Add subscription update: PATCH /subscriptions/{id}. Support partial updates and subscription versioning.

gaps.title: No NGSI-LD @context resolution
gaps.description: No JSON-LD @context resolution. Cannot compact or expand NGSI-LD entities. No linked data support.
gaps.impact: Cannot integrate with linked data sources. No JSON-LD interoperability. No context management.
gaps.recommendation: Add @context resolution: support JSON-LD compaction/expansion, context management, and linked data integration.

gaps.title: No multi-objective optimization
gaps.description: Only optimizes for coverage. No support for cost, energy, or reliability objectives. No Pareto frontier.
gaps.impact: Cannot balance coverage with cost or energy. No trade-off analysis.
gaps.recommendation: Add multi-objective optimization: weighted sum, epsilon-constraint, or NSGA-II. Support Pareto frontier visualization.

gaps.title: No sensor failure modeling
gaps.description: No modeling of sensor failures or redundancy. Cannot ensure coverage when sensors fail.
gaps.impact: No fault tolerance. Single points of failure. No redundancy planning.
gaps.recommendation: Add failure modeling: k-coverage, redundant placement, failure probability. Support reliability constraints.

gaps.title: No dynamic reconfiguration
gaps.description: Placement is static. Cannot adapt to changing conditions (new targets, moved sensors, changing priorities).
gaps.impact: Cannot adapt to changing farm conditions. No real-time optimization. No incremental updates.
gaps.recommendation: Add dynamic reconfiguration: incremental updates, real-time adaptation, event-driven re-optimization.

gaps.title: No data lineage tracking
gaps.description: No tracking of data lineage: source, transformations, processing history. Cannot trace data from sensor to analytics.
gaps.impact: Cannot debug data issues. No audit trail. No compliance with data governance.
gaps.recommendation: Add lineage tracking: source sensor, timestamps, transformations, processing steps. Support lineage visualization.

gaps.title: No data versioning
gaps.description: No versioning of sensor data. Cannot track changes or rollback to previous values.
gaps.impact: Cannot audit data changes. No rollback capability. No data history.
gaps.recommendation: Add data versioning: versioned records, change tracking, rollback support.

gaps.title: No multi-tenancy support
gaps.description: No multi-tenancy support. All data is shared. Cannot isolate data by tenant or organization.
gaps.impact: Cannot serve multiple customers. No data isolation. No tenant-specific configurations.
gaps.recommendation: Add multi-tenancy: tenant isolation, tenant-specific configurations, tenant-aware queries.

gaps.title: No data encryption at rest
gaps.description: No encryption of data at rest. Sensor data stored in plaintext.
gaps.impact: Security vulnerability. No compliance with data protection regulations.
gaps.recommendation: Add encryption at rest: AES-256 encryption, key management, envelope encryption.

immediate_priorities: Implement CoAP and LwM2M protocol support for device communication
Add device management API (registration, provisioning, lifecycle)
Add sensor data validation layer (schema, range, anomaly detection)
Implement horizontal scaling (clustering, partitioning, load balancing)
Add backpressure handling and flow control
architecture_suggestions: Adopt a microservices architecture: separate services for device management, data ingestion, data storage, and analytics
Use a message bus (Kafka or MQTT) for inter-service communication
Implement a device registry with LwM2M object mapping
Add a data quality service with validation, anomaly detection, and gap filling
Use TimescaleDB continuous aggregates for downsampling and retention
Implement a multi-tenant data isolation layer
technology_recommendations: Schema Registry: Confluent Schema Registry or Apicurio
Stream Processing: Kafka Streams or ksqlDB
Anomaly Detection: PyOD or isolation forest
Data Validation: JSON Schema or Pydantic
